List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

(Ministries:  Development of North Eastern Region; Disinvestment; Health and

Audio-visual animation agreement
with Canada
†*561. SHRI VIJAY SINGH YADAV:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
with the audio-visual animation agreement
with Canada there is possibility of business
of more than 150 million dollar every year;
(b) if so, the details thereof, togetherwith
the steps taken in this regard; and
(c) the details of the revenue earned by
the country through the animation business
as well as its export during the last three
years?
Quality of programmes and
advertisements
*562. DR. C. NARAYANA REDDY:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any mechanism to
monitor the quality of programmes and
advertisements in Cable TV channels in
view of entry of foreign channels;
(b) if so, the details of the mechanism;
and
(c) the guidelines evolved by it?
Functioning of CGHS dispensaries in
Delhi
*563. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of CGHS dispensaries
functioning at present in Delhi;
(b) the details of facilities including
Homoeopathy, Ayurvedic, Yoga, etc. being
provided in those CGHS dispensaries;
(c) the total number of CGHS
beneficiaries in Delhi;
(d) whether there is any proposal to start
more CGHS dispensaries in Delhi and
improve their functioning; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

National Press Centre
*564. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION  AND BROAD-
CASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that setting up of
National Press Centre is hanging fire since
Eighth Five Year Plan;
(b) if so, the reasons for not taking up
the project since then; and
(c) the original estimate for this project
and the revised estimate?
Water shortage in South Delhi
*565. SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is an
acute shortage of water in several areas in
South Delhi during the last few months;
(b) whether it is also a fact that a large
number of complaints have been received
from residents of Pocket C-II, Vasant Kunj,
New Delhi regarding inadequate and erratic
water supply and tankers in the area; and
(c) if so, the steps Government have
taken to augment the water supply and
provide water tankers in the area?
Classical music programme by
National AIDS Control Organisation
†*566. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned,
"Shastriya Sangeet Karyakram per lut raha
hai AIDS niyantran kosh", which appeared
in the Rashtriya Sahara, dated the
13th March, 2002;
(b)  if so, the expenditure incurred, so
far, by the National AIDS Control
Organisation (NACO) towards sponsoring
classical music programme on Doordarshan
and for how long this programme is
proposed to be sponsored; and
(c) the success achieved by the classical
music programme in controlling AIDS?
Manipulating the PGI Act
†*567. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Members of
Parliament and PGI Employees Union,
Chandigarh have drawn his attention
regarding the present Director, PGI,
Chandigarh who has shown the age as
62 years in place of 60 years in the
notification by manipulating the PGI Act
and the decision of Governing Body; and
(b) if so, the officer responsible for mis-
recording the decision and whether any
action has been taken against him?
Letter of Intent to Dr. Somervel
Memorial CSI Hospital, Kerala
*568. PROF. M. SANKARALINGAM:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether there have been irregularities
concerning inspection report and issue of
Letter of Intent to Dr. Somervel Memorial
CSI Hospital in Karakonam, Kerala by
Medical Council of India (MCI);
(b) if so, whether any action has been
taken against the erring officials;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Violation of master plan of Delhi
*569. SHRIMATI SHABANA AZMI:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is no
check on construction of new
Government buildings in the green vistas,
as reported in the Hindustan Times, dated
the 19th April, 2002;
(b) if so, the reasons for violating master
plan of Delhi by allowing such construction;
and
(c) whether Government propose to look
into the matter and prepare a legal framework
so as to save Lutyen's Delhi?
Criteria for selection of towns for
AUWSP
*570. SHRI K.M. KHAN: Will the
Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
AND POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the total number of schemes
approved under Accelerated Urban Water
Supply Programme (AUWSP) during the
year 2001-2002;
(b) the number of towns in the country
which were identified/selected and benefited
by the scheme, State-wise;
(c) the criteria for selection of towns
under the scheme; and
(d) the total amount sanctioned and spent
for various schemes approved under the
programme during the year ending
31st March, 2002?
Proposal for Connaught Place-Dwarka
Metro Project
†*571. PROF. R.B.S. VARMA: Will
the Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
AND POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have received any proposal from Delhi
Government for Metro-Rail's ambitious
Connaught Place-Dwarka Project for
approval;
(b) if so, by when Government would
sanction the proposal and send it back to
Delhi Government;
(c) the total length of the project together-
with details of stations in Dwarka; and
(d) by when  it is likely to be completed?
Inclusion of Thachar community in
SC list
*572. SHRI N.K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of
SOCIAL JUSTICE  AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to refer to
answer to Starred Question 120 given in
the Rajya Sabha on 26th November, 2001
and state:
(a) whether Government have received
any comments from the State Government
of Kerala regarding the inclusion of
'Thachar' community in the Scheduled Caste
list; and
(b) if so, the action taken thereon?
Spurious drugs
*573. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether spurious drugs are being
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

manufactured on a large scale and flooding
Indian market; and
(b) if so, the action taken to tackle the
problem on a war-footing?
Contract between HAM Dredging
Marine Contractors and CPT
*574. SHRIMATI CHANDRA KALA
PANDEY: Will the Minister of SHIPPING
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned,
"Teroso Koti Dheleo Gangar Nabyata
Bareni", which appeared in the Ananda
Bazar Patrika, Kolkata, dated the 31st
March, 2002;
(b) if so, whether there was no guarantee
on the navigable depth in the contract
between HAM Dredging Marine
Contractors and Calcutta Port Trust, as
alleged in the report;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor and the
action taken against the erring official;
(d) if not, whether his Ministry has
withheld reimbursement of Rs. 206 crore to
Calcutta Port Trust, as reported in the
news-item; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Review Committee for income criteria
for creamy layer among OBCs
*575. SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government propose to
constitute a Committee to review the income
criteria for identification of creamy layer
among Other Backward Classes; and
(b) if so, by when a final decision is
likely to be taken in this regard?
Funds for various corporations
*576. DR. A.K. PATEL: Will the
Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the funds allocated to the various
corporations for the economic upliftment of
Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and
Other Backward Classes during the
year 2001;
(b) whether State Governments like
Gujarat are closing down Leather
Development Corporations and Handloom
Corporations; and
(c) whether Government would consider
revival of these corporations which are
helpful for the rural population, Scheduled
Castes in particular?
Target and achievement of Shipping
Industry
*577. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO:
SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian shipping industry has
failed to achieve the target fixed for Ninth
Five Year Plan;
(b) if so, the target and the achievement
for the Plan period;
(c) the reasons for the wide gap between
the target and the achievement; and
(d) the steps being taken to achieve target
during the Tenth Five Year Plan?

Notification regarding medical waste
management
*578. SHRI A. VIJAYA RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any notification
regarding medical waste management for
disposing waste safely and in an
environment-friendly way;
(b) if so, the date of notification in each
State;
(c) the total number of hospitals that have
authorization certificates to dispose waste;
and
(d) the total number of hospitals that
have incinerators as on March, 2002, district-
wise, State-wise?
Delhi Metro
*579. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT AND POVERTY
ALLEVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether first phase of Delhi Metro is
likely to be completed in time;
(b) if not, by when it is likely to be
completed; and
(c) by when the second phase is likely to
be completed?
Funds for total television coverage
*580. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Planning Commission
has made funds available to her Ministry in
the Tenth Plan to ensure total television
coverage of the population;
(b) if so, whether her Ministry has
pointed out that Rs. 4,000 crore would be
needed to reach out to the remote North-
East and the far-flung areas by the existing
terrestrial network; and
(c) if so, the steps Government are
considering to take to provide television
coverage of rural and remote areas during
the Tenth Plan period?
